title: Adobe names Anil Chakravarthy as CEO from December as Narayen moves to executive chair
summary: Adobe's board named Anil Chakravarthy, president of its Customer Experience Orchestration business and worldwide field operations, as the company's next president and chief executive, effective December 1, 2026, with Shantanu Narayen — CEO since 2007 — becoming executive chair. The handover lands as AI-generated content tools reshape demand for Adobe's creative software, and investors now await the 10 September fiscal third-quarter results for a first read on the new leadership's strategy. Adobe shares slipped about 2% in extended trading after the announcement.
